svg.title: Roofer — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as roofer, wearing a work jacket and a hard hat. Visible work cue: Three overlapping roof-tile courses follow a steep slope, with staggered tile joints. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
